- Throughput: sustained 100-150 chat reqs/sec for peak synthetic tests; embeddings batch throughput ~2000 docs/min for indexing job.
- Cost sensitivity: mid — open to Dedicated reserved capacity if it reduces per-unit cost by ~25% vs hosted at scale.
- Model preferences: prefer open/Redwood-curated models (quantized variants OK). Want guidance/recommendation for quantization vs accuracy tradeoffs.
- Routing/fallback: EU-first routing, automatic failover to other regions only for read-only operations; legal wants EU-only logs/kv-cache.
